newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil called to open lower, soymeal higher.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil called to open lower, soymeal higher.

text.p: CBOT soyoil futures were called to open 0.05 to 0.10 cent per lb lower on USDA's weekly export sales report while soymeal was called to open $0.50 to $1.00 per ton higher, traders said.
USDA early Thursday said U.S. net exports of soyoil during the week ended April 24 totaled a minus 14,600 tonnes. The market was expecting a net increase of from 5,000 10 10,000 tonnes.
Net export sales of soymeal during the week were pegged by USDA at 90,200 tonnes, above expectations for 50,000 to 60,000 tonnes.
